integrity: The general result is proved directly from the p-morphism definition. The checker independently exhausts all set maps for \(n=1,2\) and agrees with the theorem.
limitations: The classification is proved only for target \(\mathbf A_1\); no claim is made for targets \(\mathbf A_m\) with \(m>1\). Finite enumeration is supplementary and covers only \(n=1,2\).
title: P-morphisms onto the two-fork are exactly Boolean colorings
